name: empty
title: Empty
description: Lists, tables, and panels with nothing to show yet.
docs:
## Installation **Command** ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/empty ``` **Manual** Use React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4 with the shadcn semantic colour tokens. Follow the [manual setup guide](https://cadence.dev/docs/installation#manual-installation) for the base CSS and aliases; copying files does not require the shadcn CLI. 1. Install the component's complete recursive npm dependencies (versions are preserved). Example-only packages are listed separately below when needed. ```package-manager npm install clsx tailwind-merge class-variance-authority ``` 2. Copy the following registry dependencies in the listed dependency order. Each JSON link exposes every file's full `content` and `target`; copy all files, including multi-file helpers. - [@cadence/cadence-utils](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) — direct registry dependency. 3. Place every file at its target below. `@components` means your components directory, for example `src/components`; keep the remaining `cadence/` tree and relative imports intact. Each source block on the website copies the entire file, including folded lines. | Item | Target file | Full source | | --- | --- | --- | | cadence-utils | `@components/cadence/lib/cn.ts` | [JSON files[].content](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) | | empty | `@components/cadence/empty/index.tsx` | [JSON files[].content](https://cadence.dev/r/empty.json) | [Source files: cadence-utils](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) [Source files: empty](https://cadence.dev/r/empty.json) 4. Apply the required CSS/configuration below, then follow [Usage](#usage) for the component imports and composition. No additional item-specific CSS configuration is required beyond the base theme. Keep `empty/index.tsx` and `lib/cn.ts` at the listed relative paths so the shared `cn` import resolves. Empty is a static T0 component in full, reduced and none modes; no motion runtime, provider or additional item-specific CSS is required beyond the base theme and Tailwind utilities. Empty's source has no `"use client"` directive and can be rendered on the server. Usage, A second action, the icon form of Icon or illustration and the top preview use `lucide-react`. Install it when keeping those icons: ```package-manager npm install lucide-react ``` Usage, A second action, Without media and the top preview use [Button](/components/button) or its `buttonVariants` export. Install it when keeping those imports: ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/button ``` For a manual Button installation, follow its Manual tab and copy every shared motion and provider file it lists. Button adds `@base-ui/react` and `motion` to the packages listed above; wrapping the application in its provider is optional. The Clear filters Button scales on press in full mode and drops that scale in reduced and none modes. The native Browse components links use `buttonVariants` for styling only and do not gain Button's press animation. Empty itself remains static. Keep A second action's `"use client"` directive for React state and event handlers; the caller owns filtering and recovery. In Next.js App Router, add `"use client"` above the imports in example files that call `buttonVariants` (including Usage and Without media), or import those compositions through an existing Client Component boundary, because this function comes from Button's client module and cannot be called directly from a Server Component. The example snippets also retain some unused icon and Button imports. Installing both dependencies supports copying them verbatim; remove unused imports if you only need the Empty parts. Bounded or unbounded and the inline SVG illustration need no extra package once those unused imports are removed. Without media needs no icon package after removing its unused icon import, but its styled link still uses `buttonVariants`. No example needs external image assets, and the site's preview frame is not consumer setup. ## Usage ```tsx import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/cadence/empty"; export function SavedComponentsEmpty() { return ( No saved components Browse the catalogue to find your first component. Browse components ); } ``` ## Bounded or unbounded Empty has no border by default. Add `border border-dashed` when the empty region needs its own boundary; leave it unbounded inside a surface that already provides one. The caller owns that surface and its height. ```tsx import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/cadence/empty"; export function EmptyBoundaries() { return (
No saved components A caller-supplied dashed boundary. Nothing to review No extra boundary inside an existing panel.
); } ``` ## A second action Use one primary recovery action and a quieter secondary route. Clear filters changes caller-owned state while the empty region stays mounted; Browse components is a real navigation link. EmptyContent stacks these controls without making them competing primary buttons. ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/cadence/empty"; export function EmptySecondAction() { const [cleared, setCleared] = useState(false); return ( No matching components {cleared ? "Filters cleared. Save a component to fill this list." : "No saved components match your filters."} Browse components ); } ``` ## Icon or illustration `variant` belongs to EmptyMedia, not Empty. `icon` frames a glyph on a muted surface; `default` leaves the media transparent for caller-provided artwork. Both examples use decorative media because the title already says what the region means. ```tsx import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/cadence/empty"; export function EmptyMediaForms() { return (
Inbox clear An icon on the muted media surface. Folder empty Transparent media for your own illustration.
); } ``` ## Without media Omit EmptyMedia when words and the next step are enough. The header keeps its spacing without an empty icon slot; this compact form can sit within a smaller panel. ```tsx import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/cadence/empty"; export function EmptyWithoutMedia() { return ( No saved components Browse the catalogue to find your first component. Browse components ); } ``` ## When to use - A list, table, or panel that is legitimately empty: no invoices, no results for this filter, a folder nobody has filled yet. - An empty state that teaches the next step — a primary action, a link to a template, or a line that explains what will appear here. - A region whose emptiness is a state, not a mistake: an inbox at zero, a fresh workspace. ## When not to use - While loading. Use `skeleton` when the shape of the incoming content is known, and `spinner` when it is not. - A search that returned nothing because of a typo. That case needs the query echoed back and the filter explained, not a generic illustration. - An error. An empty region is a normal state; a failed request is an `alert`. ## API | Part | Props | Notes | | ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | `Empty` | native div props | Centred flex column, dashed boundary, `md:p-12`. | | `EmptyHeader` | native div props | Stacks media, title, description; `max-w-sm`. | | `EmptyTitle` | native div props | Large, medium weight. Renders a `div`, not a heading. | | `EmptyDescription` | native props for `p` | Renders a `div` (upstream too): the copy often holds a block. | | `EmptyMedia` | `variant` | `"default" \| "icon"`, exposed as `data-variant`. | | `EmptyContent` | native div props | Actions; full width, `max-w-sm`, own gap. | `data-slot` values are `empty`, `empty-header`, `empty-title`, `empty-description`, `empty-icon`, `empty-content`. ## Motion contract No motion (T0). An empty state is a resting state: it is what the region looks like when nothing is happening. Fading it in would make it look like content arriving, which is the one thing it is not. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | ------- | ---------- | ----- | ------------- | | – | none | – | – | | reduced | none | – | – | | none | none | – | – | When the region swaps from empty to populated, that transition belongs to the list (`list.stagger` or `data.transition`), not to this component. ## Accessibility - The root is a plain container: no role, no live region. Announce the change of state in the region that owns it (`aria-live="polite"` on the list), not here. - `EmptyTitle` renders a `div`. If the empty state is the main content of a page, put a real heading inside it so it appears in the outline. - The media is decorative. Pass `aria-hidden` to the icon, or give the surrounding text the whole message — an icon alone never carries meaning. - Keep at least one action focusable. An empty state with no way forward is a dead end; the primary action is the reason this component exists. ## Responsiveness and performance The root can shrink with its parent and increases padding at md. Header and content have bounded widths; the caller owns the surrounding height and wrapping action rows. T0 adds no authored animation runtime or interpolation. This wrapper renders HTML/CSS; interactive children and application handlers still need their own client code. Composed controls retain their own dependencies and motion contracts. Server-rendered markup does not imply that every interaction works without JavaScript. The registry enforces a 4 KiB gzip budget for this item's own shipped source; dependencies and application bundles are measured separately. ## Notes for AI - One primary action per empty state. Two competing buttons read as a decision the user is not ready to make. - Use Empty for the content structure and spacing. The caller chooses a surrounding surface and adds a border only when that region needs a boundary. - Do not use `Empty` for a loading placeholder — `skeleton` keeps the layout stable, which `Empty` does not.
